description: This source file defines the GrainCancellationTokenSource class, which acts as a custom cancellation token source that can be transferred between grains in Orleans. It encapsulates a GrainCancellationToken and provides methods for cancellation, access to the token, and disposal.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
classes.description: A custom cancellation token source for Orleans grains, allowing cancellation signals to be propagated between grains.

methods.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new GrainCancellationToken with a unique GUID.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Property that provides access to the underlying GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: IsCancellationRequested
methods.description: Property indicating whether cancellation has been requested.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Method to request cancellation, which notifies the associated GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the GrainCancellationTokenSource.
